question: What recycling cost per kilogram does the review give for direct recycling?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%per kilo%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%USD%' OR text ILIKE '%/kg%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%direct recycl%' OR text ILIKE '%cost%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (6,9,10) ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=2 AND line_no BETWEEN 60 AND 75 ORDER BY line_no

SELECT 'ocr' src, figure_id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%cost%' OR text ILIKE '%direct%' UNION ALL SELECT 'fact', figure_id, statement FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%kg%' OR statement ILIKE '%cost%' OR statement ILIKE '%direct%' UNION ALL SELECT 'cell', table_id, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%cost%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=10 ORDER BY line_no
SELECT figure_id, line_no, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE figure_id IN ('p3.F2','p4.F3','p2.F1') ORDER BY figure_id, line_no
SELECT id, text, value, unit FROM measures WHERE array_to_string(about, ' ') ILIKE '%cost%' OR unit ILIKE '%kg%' OR unit ILIKE '%$%' OR unit ILIKE '%USD%'
SELECT count(*) FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%kilogram%' OR text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%per kg%' OR text ILIKE '%/kg%'
SELECT id, kind, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%kilogram%' OR text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%per kg%' OR text ILIKE '%/kg%'

runs.text: The review does not give a recycling cost per kilogram for direct recycling. Its only statement on direct recycling economics is qualitative: life-cycle analysis and process-based cost models are said to show that direct recycling "potentially has both economic benefits and greenhouse gas emissions reductions" over pyrometallurgical and hydrometallurgical processes. No per-kilogram cost figure appears in the text, tables, or figures. The search found no kilogram unit anywhere in the document, and the review itself notes that recycling cost of a process still needs to be evaluated (for example with the EverBatt model).
